purpose: Defines ordinary public evidence types that can expose or satisfy evidence-gated Adaptive Research possibilities. Campaigns store evidence instances with provenance/quality; nodes reference these stable type IDs.

evidence_types.name: Alien Signal
evidence_types.description: A detected non-native signal with enough structure or context to justify scientific analysis.

evidence_types.name: Alien Sample or Device
evidence_types.description: A physical non-native sample or device suitable for general xenochemical/material examination.

evidence_types.name: Captured Foreign Device
evidence_types.description: An intact or partially intact foreign engineered device under the civilization's control.

evidence_types.name: Foreign Power-System Evidence
evidence_types.description: A foreign reactor, power component, telemetry package, or equivalent evidence sufficient to study its energy system.

evidence_types.name: Foreign Propulsion Evidence
evidence_types.description: Propulsion telemetry, components, wreckage, or high-quality observations sufficient to investigate a foreign drive.

evidence_types.name: Foreign Scientific Records
evidence_types.description: Alien scientific documents, data, encoded records, or equivalent knowledge-bearing material requiring translation/interpretation.

evidence_types.name: Foreign Manufacturing Sample
evidence_types.description: A manufactured component, production sample, tooling residue, or process evidence suitable for studying foreign fabrication methods.

evidence_types.name: Alien Biological Evidence
evidence_types.description: Legitimately acquired alien biological observations or samples adequate for comparative biological research.

evidence_types.name: Hazardous Foreign Device
evidence_types.description: A foreign device whose operation/materials present an unresolved containment or safety risk.

instance_model.research_rule: Static nodes reference evidence type IDs; the runtime evaluates whether the civilization possesses a sufficiently credible instance. Evidence proves or suggests possibilities but does not automatically grant the technology.
instance_model.trade_rule: Evidence instances can eventually be traded, shared, stolen, copied, damaged, or lost according to their physical/informational nature.
instance_model.secrecy_rule: Secret discovery evidence types are not enumerated in this public file.
